verdicts.reason: A keeps the three white label boxes at readable sizes, but the reading order is scrambled to 'MAKEUP TRAVEL KIT'. The KIT box is oversized and runs off the top edge, so the word is cramped, and the background shows obvious tiled seams, including a flat gray panel. B is worse: KIT floats with no white box, so it no longer looks like the brand, and MAKEUP and TRAVEL have shrunk to illegible fine print, also out of order. B also leaves an empty white box stranded at the right edge and a mismatched gray patch, so the hierarchy is broken and the layout is unusable.
